resources.string: RetroFrame shows the photos from one folder on this device. Next you\'ll see Android\'s folder browser — open the folder your photos are in, then tap Use this folder.\n\nIf you haven\'t copied any photos across yet, Pictures or DCIM are the usual places.
Android won\'t let any app use the top level of your storage, or the Downloads folder. If you see “Can\'t use this folder”, open a folder inside it and try again.
No folder chosen yet.\n\nTap Choose folder, then open the folder your photos are in and tap “Use this folder”.
That folder has no photos or videos in it.\n\nRetroFrame also looks inside folders within it, so if the pictures really are there, they may be more than five folders deep.
That folder has no photos or videos directly in it.\n\nIf your pictures are inside folders within it, switch on “Include folders inside it” in Settings.
Could not keep access to that folder. Please try again.
Enter an alarm time as HH:mm
Could not open system settings on this device
Off sorts photos by name. Favourites only repeat when shuffle is on.
Looks up to five folders deep, so “Photos” can hold “2019”, “2020” and so on.
Moves the clock a few millimetres every minute. Left in one place for months, bright text can stain a screen permanently.
Leave blank to disable. At sleep time the clock is shown and the screen may turn off.
Screen brightness at night: leave to the tablet
Applies to clock mode only, and only while RetroFrame is on screen. Slide fully left to leave the brightness alone.
Showing photos from the whole storage volume
This device is not allowing exact alarms, so scheduled times may be up to a minute late. Tap to fix.
